name: City Pulse Multiventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, City Pulse Multiplex Ltd is in the business of multiplexes and digital media content[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in services and entertainment Industry as it deals in films, cinema halls, and F&B. At present, it is restructuring its business model to OTT platforms and is in transition phase

pros: Debtor days have improved from 836 to 156 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 34.2 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.52% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 156 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -26.5%
